response.title: which portable power station with solar panel included is the best under 500 dollars
response.answer:
For under $500 including the solar panel, I'd prioritize a portable power station with a LiFePO4 (LFP) battery, at least 250–500Wh of storage, and a 100W solar panel.

My top brands to consider are EcoFlow, BLUETTI, and Jackery. The best choice depends on whether you want maximum battery capacity, faster solar charging, or something lightweight for camping.

One important distinction: a 100W solar panel doesn't continuously generate 100W. In good sunlight, expect roughly 60–90W, so a 500Wh battery may take most of a sunny day to recharge.
